title: Northgate Optical Lab Treatment Costs on Cancelled Lens Options
content:
In an in-lab cancellation of a Northgate Optical job, the refundable part of a light-adaptive or blue-light filtering option charge is set as follows.

**Light-adaptive option.** A light-adaptive option is applied during the lab's option window, so its net charge is refunded in proportion to the part of the window not yet used: the net charge is multiplied by the window's days not yet used and divided by the window's length in days, the days used being the calendar days from the date the light-adaptive charge was posted to the day the refund is worked out, and never more than the window.

**Blue-light filtering option.** A blue-light filtering option is refunded at its net charge less a filter coating cost of 12.00, never less than zero.

**Anti-reflective option.** An anti-reflective option charge is subject to neither of these terms.

The net charge is the option charge less every credit already posted against charges of that option.

## Light-adaptive: window used and refundable part (hypothetical net charge 80.00)

| Option window | Days used | Days not yet used | Refundable part |
|---|---|---|---|
| 18 days | 9 | 9 | 80.00 multiplied by 9 and divided by 18, that is 40.00 |
| 14 days | 7 | 7 | 40.00 |
| 21 days | 0 | 21 | 80.00 |
| 14 days | 20, counted as 14 | 0 | 0.00 |

## Blue-light filtering: refundable part (hypothetical net charges)

| Net charge | Less filter coating cost 12.00 | Refundable part |
|---|---|---|
| 30.00 | 18.00 | 18.00 |
| 25.50 | 13.50 | 13.50 |
| 10.00 | below zero | 0.00 |
